answer.rationale: Regional failover proven to restore latency during primary region degradation (memory_b2). Routing read replicas offloaded primary load during heavy write peaks before (memory_b5), but current degradation is write-path p99 latency, not dashboard reads. Failover moves traffic to a healthy region, directly addressing the 5x p99 spike confined to primary, while settlement peak passes. Both memories support the choice: memory_b2 shows traffic shifted cleanly and error rates recovered within minutes during March degradation; memory_b5 shows write latency recovered same day when routing to replicas. Prioritizing failover avoids losing customer writes (traffic shifts cleanly) and sustains availability during the peak window.
